newsitem.title: USA: Dana Q3 international sales up 10 pct.
newsitem.headline: Dana Q3 international sales up 10 pct.

text.p: Dana Corp said Monday that strong worldwide sales of light trucks and sport utility vehicles continue to offsett weak U.S. demand for heavy trucks.

The company reported third quarter earnings of $0.64 per share on sales of $1.82 billion, compared to a year-ago sales figure of $1.73 billion. It said international sales rose 10 percent compared to a 3 percent increase in U.S. sales.

"Our goal is to increase international sales to 50 percent of our total by the year 2000," the company stated, noting that 21 of its 24 acquisitions and joint ventures during the past three-and-a-half years involve companies outside the U.S.
